quote: For example, if we do not winsorize in this way in Replication 1, the work-frame p-value becomes .264 instead of .270, and the leisure-frame p-value remains at .088.
reason: The primary source is confirmed as Data Colada [97] (May 4, 2021, by Joe & Leif) replicating Etkin and Memmi (2020) Study 1a. Footnote 4 explicitly reports that in the primary winsorized analysis of Replication 1, the work-frame p-value is .270 (as opposed to .264 without winsorization), matching the shipped value 0.27.
